_about: The paint of the cantonal road Magliaso - Pura as v1.1 built it from the photos (state of October 2022, markings_decals.py / markings_state.py), kept for markings_rules.py: 'white' points of white paint every 0.5 m (where the centre and edge lines were), 'red_bands' the red edge bands (polygons), 'unmarked' the stretches the panoramas showed without paint, 'route' the road's axis.
